profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Netsmart Technologies, Inc.
profile.summary:
PROBLEM ****ANALYZE, PLAN, EXECUTE**** SOLVED

For over 20 years I have served my stakeholders with software solutions to enable them to prosper.  The Microsoft suite of development applications have been my tools of choice.  Whether it’s ASP.NET websites, transferring JSON or XML using WCF, working with JavaScript, JQuery, Telerik, or complex T-SQL queries, triggers or stored procedures I can help any organization achieve their goals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for conversion of legacy applications to Cross-Browser solutions utilizing current technology and frameworks.  Coordinates with a team of developers with written and verbal specs.  Provides  developer level customer support.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description: Participated in the maintenance of loan origination software ACTion.  Generated technical designs for enhancements in coordination with a team of developers.  Helped in translating government regulations into functional design.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Assisted in the architecture, development, and maintenance of a commercial web application EvolvCS.  Created specifications, test plans and conducted developer level unit tests.  Debugged, troubleshoot and provided customer support.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Assisted in the design and development of web application CUSIP Access.  Developed a Java applet that generated temporary CUSIP numbers on-demand for new securities.  Created and maintained Unix scripts to process data feeds from remote mainframes into an Oracle database.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Assisted in the development of a desktop mutual fund trading system application.  Monitored daily data feeds of mutual fund trading transactions.  Developed monthly statement reports for mutual fund stockholders.  Provide phone-assisted and on-site software support.

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description: Developed a multi-user library management application and administered in-house library proprietary databases.  Provided in-house training to accounting staff in the use MS Office

educations.schoolName: High School of Art and Design

certifications.name: Application Security and Secure Coding Training in .NET
certifications.title: Application Security and Secure Coding Training in .NET

volunteerExperiences.description: Marietta Community Outreach - Weekend outing for low income housing.  Games, food, music, movies as well as closing and school supplies give aways.
